reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch read the "selfsame day" of Genesis 7:13 as a pluperfect, meaning Noah had completed boarding over the preceding seven days rather than beginning that day.

sides.snippet: Noah went into the ark with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives, because of the waters of the flood.
sides.verseText: Noah went into the ark with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives, because of the waters of the flood.

sides.snippet: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ark
sides.verseText: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ark;
